vulg: Paulus vinctus Iesu Christi et Timotheus frater Philemoni dilecto et adiutori nostro
clem: Paulus vinctus Christi Jesu, et Timotheus frater, Philemoni dilecto, et adjutori nostro,
tr: παυλος δεσμιος χριστου ιησου και τιμοθεος ο αδελφος φιλημονι τω αγαπητω και συνεργω ημων
kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

vulg: et Appiae sorori et Archippo commilitoni nostro et ecclesiae quae in domo tua est
clem: et Appi sorori carissim, et Archippo commilitoni nostro, et ecclesi, qu in domo tua est.
tr: και απφια τη αγαπητη και αρχιππω τω συστρατιωτη ημων και τη κατ οικον σου εκκλησια
kjv: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

vulg: gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre nostro et Domino Iesu Christo
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: gratias ago Deo meo semper memoriam tui faciens in orationibus meis
clem: Gratias ago Deo meo, semper memoriam tui faciens in orationibus meis,
tr: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου παντοτε μνειαν σου ποιουμενος επι των προσευχων μου
kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

vulg: audiens caritatem tuam et fidem quam habes in Domino Iesu et in omnes sanctos
clem: audiens caritatem tuam, et fidem, quam habes in Domino Jesu, et in omnes sanctos:
tr: ακουων σου την αγαπην και την πιστιν ην εχεις προς τον κυριον ιησουν και εις παντας τους αγιους
kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

vulg: ut communicatio fidei tuae evidens fiat in agnitione omnis boni in nobis in Christo Iesu
clem: ut communicatio fidei tu evidens fiat in agnitione omnis operis boni, quod est in vobis in Christo Jesu.
tr: οπως η κοινωνια της πιστεως σου ενεργης γενηται εν επιγνωσει παντος αγαθου του εν υμιν εις χριστον ιησουν
kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

vulg: gaudium enim magnum habui et consolationem in caritate tua quia viscera sanctorum requieverunt per te frater
clem: Gaudium enim magnum habui, et consolationem in caritate tua: quia viscera sanctorum requieverunt per te, frater.
tr: χαριν  χαραν  γαρ εχομεν πολλην και παρακλησιν επι τη αγαπη σου οτι τα σπλαγχνα των αγιων αναπεπαυται δια σου αδελφε
kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

vulg: propter quod multam fiduciam habentes in Christo Iesu imperandi tibi quod ad rem pertinet
clem: Propter quod multam fiduciam habens in Christo Jesu imperandi tibi quod ad rem pertinet:
tr: διο πολλην εν χριστω παρρησιαν εχων επιτασσειν σοι το ανηκον
kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

vulg: propter caritatem magis obsecro cum sis talis ut Paulus senex nunc autem et vinctus Iesu Christi
clem: propter caritatem magis obsecro, cum sis talis, ut Paulus senex, nunc autem et vinctus Jesu Christi:
tr: δια την αγαπην μαλλον παρακαλω τοιουτος ων ως παυλος πρεσβυτης νυνι δε και δεσμιος ιησου χριστου
kjv: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

vulg: obsecro te de meo filio quem genui in vinculis Onesimo
clem: obsecro te pro meo filio, quem genui in vinculis, Onesimo,
tr: παρακαλω σε περι του εμου τεκνου ον εγεννησα εν τοις δεσμοις μου ονησιμον
kjv: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

vulg: qui tibi aliquando inutilis fuit nunc autem et tibi et mihi utilis
clem: qui tibi aliquando inutilis fuit, nunc autem et mihi et tibi utilis,
tr: τον ποτε σοι αχρηστον νυνι δε σοι και εμοι ευχρηστον
kjv: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

vulg: quem remisi tu autem illum id est mea viscera suscipe
clem: quem remisi tibi. Tu autem illum, ut mea viscera, suscipe:
tr: ον ανεπεμψα (1:12) συ δε αυτον τουτ εστιν τα εμα σπλαγχνα προσλαβου
kjv: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

vulg: quem ego volueram mecum detinere ut pro te mihi ministraret in vinculis evangelii
clem: quem ego volueram mecum detinere, ut pro te mihi ministraret in vinculis Evangelii:
tr: ον εγω εβουλομην προς εμαυτον κατεχειν ινα υπερ σου διακονη μοι εν τοις δεσμοις του ευαγγελιου
kjv: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

vulg: sine consilio autem tuo nihil volui facere uti ne velut ex necessitate bonum tuum esset sed voluntarium
clem: sine consilio autem tuo nihil volui facere, uti ne velut ex necessitate bonum tuum esset, sed voluntarium.
tr: χωρις δε της σης γνωμης ουδεν ηθελησα ποιησαι ινα μη ως κατα αναγκην το αγαθον σου η αλλα κατα εκουσιον
kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

vulg: forsitan enim ideo discessit ad horam a te ut aeternum illum recipere
clem: Forsitan enim ideo discessit ad horam a te, ut ternum illum reciperes:
tr: ταχα γαρ δια τουτο εχωρισθη προς ωραν ινα αιωνιον αυτον απεχης
kjv: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

vulg: iam non ut servum sed plus servo carissimum fratrem maxime mihi quanto autem magis tibi et in carne et in Domino
clem: jam non ut servum, sed pro servo carissimum fratrem, maxime mihi: quanto autem magis tibi et in carne, et in Domino?
tr: ουκετι ως δουλον αλλ υπερ δουλον αδελφον αγαπητον μαλιστα εμοι ποσω δε μαλλον σοι και εν σαρκι και εν κυριω
kjv: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

vulg: si ergo habes me socium suscipe illum sicut me
clem: Si ergo habes me socium, suscipe illum sicut me:
tr: ει ουν εμε εχεις κοινωνον προσλαβου αυτον ως εμε
kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

vulg: si autem aliquid nocuit tibi aut debet hoc mihi inputa
clem: si autem aliquid nocuit tibi, aut debet, hoc mihi imputa.
tr: ει δε τι ηδικησεν σε η οφειλει τουτο εμοι ελλογει
kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

vulg: ego Paulus scripsi mea manu ego reddam ut non dicam tibi quod et te ipsum mihi debes
clem: Ego Paulus scripsi mea manu: ego reddam, ut non dicam tibi, quod et teipsum mihi debes:
tr: εγω παυλος εγραψα τη εμη χειρι εγω αποτισω ινα μη λεγω σοι οτι και σεαυτον μοι προσοφειλεις
kjv: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

vulg: ita frater ego te fruar in Domino refice viscera mea in Domino
clem: ita, frater. Ego te fruar in Domino: refice viscera mea in Domino.
tr: ναι αδελφε εγω σου οναιμην εν κυριω αναπαυσον μου τα σπλαγχνα εν κυριω
kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

vulg: confidens oboedientia tua scripsi tibi sciens quoniam et super id quod dico facies
clem: Confidens in obedientia tua scripsi tibi: sciens quoniam et super id, quod dico, facies.
tr: πεποιθως τη υπακοη σου εγραψα σοι ειδως οτι και υπερ ο λεγω ποιησεις
kjv: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

vulg: simul autem et para mihi hospitium nam spero per orationes vestras donari me vobis
clem: Simul autem et para mihi hospitium: nam spero per orationes vestras donari me vobis.
tr: αμα δε και ετοιμαζε μοι ξενιαν ελπιζω γαρ οτι δια των προσευχων υμων χαρισθησομαι υμιν
kjv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

vulg: salutat te Epaphras concaptivus meus in Christo Iesu
clem: Salutat te Epaphras concaptivus meus in Christo Jesu,
tr: ασπαζονται σε επαφρας ο συναιχμαλωτος μου εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

vulg: Marcus Aristarchus Demas Lucas adiutores mei
clem: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, et Lucas, adjutores mei.
tr: μαρκος αρισταρχος δημας λουκας οι συνεργοι μου
kjv: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

vulg: gratia Domini nostri Iesu Christi cum spiritu vestro amen
clem: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum spiritu vestro. Amen.
tr: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα του πνευματος υμων αμην [ προς φιλημονα εγραφη απο ρωμης δια ονησιμου οικετου]
kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
